title: Ophthalmic Laboratory Technicians
description: Cut, grind, and polish eyeglasses, contact lenses, or other precision optical elements. Assemble and mount lenses into frames or process other optical elements. Includes precision lens polishers or grinders, centerer-edgers, and lens mounters.

tasks.text: Mount and secure lens blanks or optical lenses in holding tools or chucks of cutting, polishing, grinding, or coating machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Inspect lens blanks to detect flaws, verify smoothness of surface, and ensure thickness of coating on lenses.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Flaw location on physical products needs presence

dwas.name: Inspect finished products to locate flaws.

tasks.text: Set up machines to polish, bevel, edge, or grind lenses, flats, blanks, or other precision optical elements.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Glass shaping is skilled manual hot work

dwas.name: Shape glass or similar materials.

tasks.text: Inspect, weigh, and measure mounted or unmounted lenses after completion to verify alignment and conformance to specifications, using precision instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Weigh finished products.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Shape lenses appropriately so that they can be inserted into frames.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Glass shaping is skilled manual hot work

dwas.name: Shape glass or similar materials.

tasks.text: Clean finished lenses and eyeglasses, using cloths and solvents.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of physical workpieces

dwas.name: Clean workpieces or finished products.

tasks.text: Mount, secure, and align finished lenses in frames or optical assemblies, using precision hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

tasks.text: Examine prescriptions, work orders, or broken or used eyeglasses to determine specifications for lenses, contact lenses, or other optical elements.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.

tasks.text: Adjust lenses and frames to correct alignment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual repair of assistive devices

dwas.name: Repair medical or dental assistive devices.

tasks.text: Select lens blanks, molds, tools, and polishing or grinding wheels, according to production specifications.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Select production equipment according to product specifications.

tasks.text: Position and adjust cutting tools to specified curvature, dimensions, and depth of cut.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control setting for cutting

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.
Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.

tasks.text: Assemble eyeglass frames and attach shields, nose pads, and temple pieces, using pliers, screwdrivers, and drills.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Customized device construction is hands-on fabrication

dwas.name: Construct customized assistive medical or dental devices.

tasks.text: Set dials and start machines to polish lenses or hold lenses against rotating wheels to polish them manually.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Polish materials, workpieces, or finished products.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Repair broken parts, using precision hand tools and soldering irons.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Soldering requires fine manual dexterity

dwas.name: Solder parts or workpieces.
Repair medical or dental assistive devices.

tasks.text: Immerse eyeglass frames in solutions to harden, soften, or dye frames.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Immersing workpieces in solutions by hand

dwas.name: Immerse objects or workpieces in cleaning or coating solutions.

tasks.text: Lay out lenses and trace lens outlines on glass, using templates.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drawing guide lines on materials is hands-on

dwas.name: Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.

tasks.text: Control equipment that coats lenses to alter their reflective qualities.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual spray/coating control requires dexterity and judgment

dwas.name: Operate painting or coating equipment.

tasks.text: Remove lenses from molds and separate lenses in containers for further processing or storage.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Removing workpieces from molds is physical

dwas.name: Remove workpieces from molds.

emerging_tasks.task: Tint lenses according to customer specifications.
